messages:
alex: Ugh CI red on PR #842 — ubuntu-20 / encoder_context_test keeps failing (job 6721). Any way to rerun only that job? Don't want a full matrix rebuild.
ci-bot: [auto] build 6721 failed (ubuntu-20) — test: encoder_context_test. Flake count: 3. To rerun a specific step: use the CI web UI -> Build 6721 -> Restart step, or use the CLI: `bk restart --build 6721 --step "ubuntu-20"`. To rerun the whole PR use `/retest`.
meera: If you're on GitHub Actions, the quick route is Actions -> run -> Re-run failed jobs. CLI: `gh run rerun 6721` (works for whole run). If it's flaky repeatedly try setting `FLAKE_ATTEMPTS=3` for that job to auto-retry.
jon: We also have a convenience script that avoids re-triggering the whole matrix: `./scripts/ci/rebuild_failed.sh 6721`. It rebuilds artifacts and reruns just the failing test job. Works for most python/c++ tests.
sam: I can kick that off for you now, @alex. Want me to rerun job 6721 or do you want to try one of the commands above? :thumbsup:
alex: please go ahead and rerun 6721, thanks. Hold off on bisect until we see the rerun.
sam: kicked it. ci-bot should post the new run id in a sec.
ci-bot: [auto] restarted build 6722 (parent 6721) — queued. Link: https://ci.internal/builds/6722
meera: If 6722 still fails, grab the failing test log and run a quick local repro: `pytest tests/encoder/test_context.py::test_encoder_context -k "encoder_context_test" -q`. If repro is flaky locally, we should bisect.
alex: good plan. If 6722 fails I'll paste logs here.
jon: For a guided bisect we have `scripts/ci/run_bisect --test encoder_context_test --good <sha> --bad <sha>` — it automates running tests across commits and uploads results. Ping me and I can help configure the two SHAs.
sam: 6722 started running. I'll update once green/fail.
ci-bot: [auto] build 6722 running -> step ubuntu-20 started.
